title: Unattended or Suspicious Death
summary: First-officer steps at a death scene.

steps.text: Confirm death; request EMS if there is any doubt
Secure the scene and start an entry log
Do not move or cover the body unless necessary; note anything EMS moved
Notify a supervisor and detectives per policy
Position of the body, injuries, clothing
Doors, windows, lights, thermostat, mail and newspapers
Who found the decedent, and when the person was last known alive

steps.detail: Violent, suspicious, sudden or unattended deaths are reportable

steps.text: Next-of-kin notification in person when possible

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
